BJP Replaces Bankipur Candidate Amid Fodder Scam Allegations

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) replaced its candidate for the Bankipur by-election in Bihar following a controversy linked to the fodder scam. The initial candidate, Abhishek Sinha, was replaced by Neeraj Sinha. This change occurred shortly before the withdrawal deadline. The Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) criticized the BJP, stating that the son of the "originator of the fodder scam" was their minister. Political strategist Prashant Kishor described the candidate swap as unprecedented in a Bihar by-election.
